answer: Assembling that for 56 aliases means 56 times 6 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Because each oasis escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the relic ledger records every share and the fable audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 35 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
